name: MS3 Corp. Architects
what_they_do: Architecture practice doing architectural design, renovations and project administration, with public-sector project work referenced on its (now unreachable) site.
customers: Inference: municipal/public agencies and private building owners needing design and construction administration, based on the public-projects section of the site.

size_signals.signal: Google listing categorised 'Architect' at 36 Monticello Way with phone (848) 218-1744
Site (per search snippets) advertises architectural design, renovations and project administration with public-project examples — small practice scale on a residential street

listing.reviews: count not shown in limited view

website_review.out_of_date_signs: https://www.ms3corp.com returns ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID in Chrome, so visitors hit a security warning; http://ms3corp.com serves a bare InMotion Hosting placeholder page and /services.html returns 404 — the site is effectively down
website_review.search_basics: Search engines still index titles such as 'MS3 Corp. Architects | Services' with service and public-project pages, but a customer cannot reach them; no JSON-LD or robots.txt could be checked
top_issues: HTTPS certificate is invalid — every visitor sees a security warning
Domain appears to be parked/unconfigured on hosting, with 404s on known pages
Google profile is unclaimed with no hours and no service description

agent_readiness.notes: Google profile exists (5.0, category 'Architect', phone, website link) but is unclaimed — 'Claim this business' and 'Add hours' prompts are showing and it has no hours. The linked website cannot be loaded over HTTPS due to a certificate mismatch, so there is no readable content for crawlers or assistants, no form and no booking. robots.txt could not be retrieved.

operations_signals.signal: A broken public website means project inquiries arrive only by phone to a single number (inference)
Public-sector work implies proposal and RFQ paperwork handled manually (inference from the public-projects positioning)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Restore the website: fix the TLS certificate and DNS/hosting so ms3corp.com loads, then re-publish the service and public-project pages
top_opportunities.evidence: Chrome shows ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID; http serves an InMotion Hosting placeholder; /services.html returns 404

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim the Google Business Profile and add hours, services, project photos and a working website link
top_opportunities.evidence: Unclaimed listing with 'Add hours' prompt and no service description

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a project-inquiry form with document upload for RFQ/proposal packets, plus LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService schema once the site is live
top_opportunities.evidence: No reachable site means no form, no schema and no way to submit a project brief online

scores.reasons: A firm whose website throws a certificate error has the most visible breakage in the batch, and a certificate/DNS fix plus listing claim is fast; an architecture practice with public projects has decent budget, and the failure was reproduced directly in the browser.
